+verified against the committed Git bytes. The archive includes the editable
+article ZIP, cover-letter ZIP, manuscript PDF, cover-letter PDF, AI declaration,

+The DOI identifies the immutable release checkpoint; it does not assert that
+later receipt files were already inside that earlier checkpoint. The released
+source manifest remains recoverable at the exact archived commit above.
+No journal submission or acceptance is claimed.
